backendTests.scope: Navigation route validity, server-rendered page contracts and authorization, plus targeted recipe-removal mutations and inventory/cost preservation. This does not claim a full business mutation suite or every visual/data/permission state.

invoicePdfRender.method: Production InvoicePdfRenderer with an entirely in-memory fictional invoice; generated PDF rasterized and visually inspected.
invoicePdfRender.font: Cairo Regular/Bold; Arabic shaping, OTL and RTL retained.
invoicePdfRender.writeProtection: Render harness rejects every database statement except SELECT; invoice, order, item, branch and issuer fixtures were not persisted.

dialogFocusRuntime.scope: Actual setup handlers with DOM doubles; browser verification recorded separately

recipeRemovalPolicy.issue: Bottled water exposed its own bottle as a removable recipe ingredient.
recipeRemovalPolicy.policy: recipe_items.is_removable defaults true for existing menus. Eligibility is shared by customer/waiter payloads and server validation; optional costing stays independent.
coverage: Customer and waiter payloads omit protected ingredients

scopedGlobalSelectorAudit.scope: Every scoped SFC style inspected using PostCSS rules and emitted Vue compiler CSS. Whole selectors inside :global(...) preserve their intended descendants.
